security_implications: Static mask is constant all-ones (line 911) when EnMasking is active. This completely removes entropy from the masking scheme and can expose the secret key processed in kmac_core to power/EM side-channel analysis. The lifecycle escalation input lc_escalate_en[1] (line 895) is a critical security control; an erroneous width assumption could disable escalation. The sparse FSM error (line 898) and key index error (line 899) outputs are explicitly wired for error alerting, reinforcing the high-security context of this block.
